## Android: the bottom bar in the page colour
- The strip at the very bottom behind the gesture handle (navigation bar) now takes the colour of the page, like the status bar at the top: black in OLED mode, light in light mode, the background of each theme, and the colour of the queue or lyrics sheet when it fills the screen
- The buttons of the navigation bar turn dark on a light page

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
